evidence: In 2017, Kerrigan et al. demonstrated the possibility to synthesize metallic Co by thermal ALD, testing several precursors and substrates. In particular, the use of the bis(1,4-ditert-butyl-1,3-diazadienyl)cobalt (Co(t-Bu2DAD)2), (1), and tertbutylamine (tBuNH2), (2), precursors favored a highly controllable ALD process in the 170–200 °C ALD thermal window.
